summary: CIBC filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $1.07 per common share for the quarter ending October 31, 2026, payable October 28, 2026 to shareholders of record September 28, 2026. Dividends on multiple Class A Preferred Share series were also declared with varying record and payment dates in October 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration by the issuer, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, advisory roles, or strategic actions involved; it is a standard recurring corporate announcement.
